text:
sarah: quick question — when we show the "effective authn policy" in the Console for API keys, do we surface routing policy + quota bucket + project attribution by default? worried it might overwhelm users. :thinking:

ton: imo keep the top-level line minimal: show the active policy name and which tenant it matched. expand/collapse for details. most people just want to know "why did my request route to X?"

priya: agreed with ton. also flag that telemetry ingestion will spike if we dump full policy blobs on every row. sampling or on-demand fetch would be safer. we have budget limits on observability.

raul: +1 on sampling. another UX point — we should include the resolution timestamp and the routing decision chain (policy -> fallback -> model-variant). even a small breadcrumb helps debugging.

sarah: makes sense. thinking about the default view: show: policy_name, matched_scope (org|project|sa), quota_bucket, resolution_ts. details panel: whole policy and matched rules. does that cover it?

ton: yea. for rollout let's behind-flag it. feature flag: `console.authn_policy_details` default off for orgs with >100k requests/day. enable for admins.

priya: also add a throttle on detail fetches: 1 detail-per-10s/user to avoid accidental storms. implementation sketch:
```json
{
  "routingPolicy": "org_affinity",
  "matchedScope": "project:acme-corp",
  "quotaBucket": "standard-read",
  "resolutionTs": "2026-03-21T18:12:45Z"
}
```

raul: what about noisy projects that change policies frequently? telemetry should emit a sampling marker + policy_version id so we can correlate regressions without capturing entire policy every time.

priya: yes: add `policy_version` and `sampled:true/false`. backend delta: store last-known-policy-per-project to render details if sampled=false but requested by admin (pull sync).

ton: UX rollout plan: 1) internal canary orgs, 2) opt-in via admin toggle, 3) auto-enable for orgs that request support. also add analytics event `console.authn_detail_view` with sample rate.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: web-console v3.14.2 -> canary (tag: authn-policy-ux) — ETA 18:45 UTC :rocket:

sarah: ok i'll open a tiny RFC with the fields and flag gating. will also add a note to the telemetry budget docs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ton: small nit — please include a link to the routing policy editor from the detail view (saves clicks).

priya: logging followup: recommend we redact any sensitive matcher values by default (user ids, tokens). store only hashed identifiers in telemetry.

raul: filing a follow-up issue to add `policy_version` to A/B regressions dashboard.

sarah: perfect. filing the RFC now -> https://go/redwood/rfcs/7345678901 (draft).
